en: A vintage black‑and‑white panoramic view of a city nestled in a valley surrounded by mountains. The foreground shows a river with a bridge, rail tracks, and dense urban buildings. In the center and right are several church towers and historic-looking structures, indicating an old town core. The image is bordered like an old postcard, with the caption "Trento" printed in cursive at the bottom.
